Definition: from G5142; nourishment (literally or figuratively); by implication, rations (wages):--food, meat.
BiblicalUsage: trophḗ is the ordinary word for nourishment. It appears 16 times in Scripture, including Matthew 6:25 and Acts 14:17.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that trophḗ is one of the small details that matter in Scripture.
